name: Cynosure

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: Alloy Casing
perks.desc:
Reduces weight for faster reloads.
  •  Greatly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: Black Powder
perks.desc:
This weapon's explosives are more effective.
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Impact Casing
perks.desc:
Increased damage on direct hits.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Tracking Module
perks.desc: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights.

perks.name: Sympathetic Arsenal
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow also reloads stowed weapons.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.desc: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.desc: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Bipod
perks.desc: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.

perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.desc: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Lasting Impression
perks.desc: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Increases blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.desc: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Vanguard's Vindication
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

perks.name: Suros Synergy
perks.desc: Reloading grants this weapon bonus handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time.

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon increases reload speed and Sword charge rate and slightly increases damage.

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.desc: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 133 from 11 March 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/49VFDRj05iDXTJDOBqQpga?si=e61731a19fb64938) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for dealing with Majors in both general at-level or better, and end-game underlevelled content. It's been a few seasons since the last new adaptive frame rocket launcher, but Cynosure brings that wait to an end. If you're after a roll, remember to reset your Vanguard reputation as many times as you're able, to maximise your chances from the 12×12 trait perk options. At base, the stats are okay by comparison with its peers - 54 Velocity equates to 36.02m/s, 44 Stability is ×1.1270 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 41 Handling is 0.50s ready, 0.44s ADS and 0.41s stow speed, and 39 Reload Speed is a 3.27s reload. With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo is 8/9/10/11 (max 11). You can boost Handling and/or Velocity with the barrel and magazine perks, or use Impact Casing to boost overall damage by ×1.022. I you don't have a rocket launcher roll for boss damage then in the first trait perk column, Overflow or Reconstruction both overflow the magazine to front-load a damage phase, or Field Prep provides the equivalent of a reserve mod (2 when enhanced) and boosts Reload Speed and ready/stow speed. In the second column, Explosive Light provides an easy ×1.25 damage boost for six shots (7 when enhanced) for just picking up power orbs. If you're interested, "Cynosure" could be something or someone at the centre of attention, someone who directs or guides, or the Ursa Major constellation - take your pick! Suros Synergy is the more useful origin trait, providing +40 Handling and ×1.2 flinch resistance for 6s after a reload. Recommended MW: Velocity or Handling with a Quick Access Sling mod or, when the champion mod's on the seasonal artifact, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "It's like Bungie wants us to replace Hothead but Hothead just looks better. If you missed Hothead then Cynosure is alright and comes with competitive perks. Reconstruction, Field Prep and Clown Cartridge are your bread and butter, but perks like Overflow, Ambitious Assassin, and even Demolitionist are all great too. Pair that with Explosive Light or High Ground for more damage or Bipod for even more rockets and you might never need to reload." Recommended MW: Blast Radius.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Cynosure exists like all heavy weapons do in PvP. Placeholders for the one time you pick up heavy every 7 games. Tracking Module will help you land your one rocket, and things like Chain Reaction or Cluster Bomb will possibly net you more than one kill. But let's be honest, heavies in PvP are usually hit or miss (*zing*!)" Recommended MW: Blast Radius.
